# The durable scoped-mode marker and principal retry bindings survive both
# daemon restart and an offline database snapshot restored with current auth.
# Token outputs and auth files in this workdir need a private parent.
chmod 0700 .
skygo auth init --data-dir $DATA --auth-file $AUTH --token-output admin.token
skygo auth principal add alice --role operator --auth-file $AUTH
skygo auth principal add bob --role operator --auth-file $AUTH
skygo auth token issue alice --auth-file $AUTH --output alice.token --expires-in 24h
skygo auth token issue bob --auth-file $AUTH --output bob.token --expires-in 24h
server start
taskfile success.json success
skygo --token-file alice.token --json run -f success.json --request-id durable --wait
job-id ALICE
skygo auth token issue alice --auth-file $AUTH --output alice-new.token --expires-in 24h
token-id alice.token OLD_ALICE
skygo auth token revoke $OLD_ALICE --auth-file $AUTH
await-auth unauthenticated alice.token jobs get $ALICE
server stop
! stderr .

# An activated store cannot silently return to anonymous or single-token mode.
! skygo server --data-dir $DATA --listen 127.0.0.1:0
stderr '(auth|scoped)'
! skygo server --data-dir $DATA --auth-file $AUTH --token forbidden-legacy-token --listen 127.0.0.1:0
! stderr 'forbidden-legacy-token'
skygo state backup --data-dir $DATA --output scoped.db
[s01-binary] fenced-refusal $DATA/jobs.db
skygo state restore --input scoped.db --data-dir restored
server-directory restored
server start
skygo --token-file alice-new.token --json run -f success.json --request-id durable --wait
stdout '"id": *"'$ALICE'"'
! skygo --token-file alice.token jobs get $ALICE
stderr '^unauthenticated: '
! skygo --token-file bob.token jobs get $ALICE
stderr '^not_found: '
skygo --token-file bob.token --json jobs list
! stdout '"id"'
skygo --token-file admin.token jobs get $ALICE
! stderr .
server stop
! stderr .
server start
skygo --token-file alice-new.token --json run -f success.json --request-id durable --wait
stdout '"id": *"'$ALICE'"'
server stop
! stderr .
